# telnyx_email_domain_webhook (Data Source)

A webhook that receives the events of an email domain, such as deliveries, bounces and verification changes.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The email domain the webhook belongs to.
- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `events` (Set of String) Allowlist of event types delivered to this webhook. At least one event is required — there is no default-to-all.
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint to deliver subscribed events to.
